meta.title: Workout Tracker
meta.description: Log your workouts, plan your week, and track your progress.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.expired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

errors.userExists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in or use a different email.
errors.validation: Fix the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check that the backend is running and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

errors.title: This page couldn't load
errors.description: An unexpected error occurred. Try again, and if it keeps happening, reload the page.
errors.notFoundDescription: The address may have changed, or the page doesn't exist.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Today's workouts from the planner, your training streak, and a quick summary.
dashboard.summary: Streak: {streak, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} in a row · Workouts logged: {total}

log.title: Log workout
log.description: Check off your planned sets, adjust weight and reps, and see records the moment you hit them.

picker.nothingBody: Start an empty workout, or plan your week in the planner.
picker.error: Couldn't start the workout. Try again.

ai.title: Add from description
ai.hint: Describe what you did. AI matches exercises from the catalog and adds the sets as done.
ai.placeholder: e.g. bench press 3x8 80 kg, then flyes 3x12 14 kg
ai.added: {count, plural, one {Added # exercise} other {Added # exercises}} from the description
ai.nothing: AI didn't recognize any exercises. Try describing them in more detail.
ai.error: AI is unavailable right now. Add sets manually or try again shortly.

finish.title: Finish workout?
finish.unchecked: {count, plural, one {# set isn't checked off} other {# sets aren't checked off}}.
finish.pendingWarning: Some changes aren't saved yet. Wait for the connection.

toast.offline: You're offline. Changes will save automatically.

emptyWorkout.title: Empty workout
emptyWorkout.body: Add your first exercise from the catalog, or describe the workout and AI will recognize it.

workouts.title: Workout history
workouts.description: Your logged workouts, with date filtering and duplication.

workoutDetail.title: Workout #{id}
workoutDetail.description: Workout details: exercises, sets, and notes.

planner.title: Planner
planner.description: A calendar of scheduled workouts: generate a schedule from a plan, change status, and start a workout.

plans.title: Workout plans
plans.description: Plans that group templates, including AI-generated plans based on your goal and training days.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Reusable workout templates with target sets, reps, weight, and rest time.

templateDetail.title: Template #{id}
templateDetail.description: The template's exercises and their targets.

stats.title: Stats
stats.description: Exercise progress, personal records, muscle group distribution, and training frequency.

exercises.title: Exercise catalog
exercises.description: All exercises, grouped by muscle group.

exerciseDetail.title: Exercise #{id}
exerciseDetail.description: Exercise details, your records, and similar exercises.

admin.title: Admin panel
admin.description: Manage the global exercise catalog and user accounts.

adminExercises.title: Manage exercises
adminExercises.description: Add, edit, and delete exercises, and backfill embeddings for similar-exercise search.
